sources.title: RapidOCR Open Source OCR Toolkit - RapidOCR Documentation
sources.snippet: RapidOCR is a completely open source OCR toolkit that supports offline deployment across platforms and languages, for Python, C++, Java, C# and edge device scenarios.

sources.title: RapidOCR Model List - RapidOCR Documentation
sources.snippet: Model List Overview RapidOCR provides converted PaddleOCR models in ONNX, OpenVINO, MNN, PaddlePaddle and PyTorch formats. TensorRT engines are built dynamically from the corresponding ONNX model on first use. Models are hosted on ModelScope. In rapidocr>=3.10.0, model selection is routed by default_models.yaml.
